observations: D-R27-01 regression seed (sB1: loaded_pack back to 5.456 V x 1.46 A, budget regenerated with r10_parts.py --budget-only): parts_budget.json lines 91-92 return to 5.899191 / 4.414002 V and nothing fails: r10_parts.py --check rc 0, test_r10_parts 5/5 OK, no check_r10 rule or test pins pack_*_four_stall_loaded_V, and the full test_r10_check on that copy passes (268 OK, 6 skipped). STATUS.md, parts_qualification.md and R10_VALIDATION.md would then quote 5.881 / 4.389 V against a 5.899 / 4.414 V budget. This is the class the round 26 triage ruled not a gate miss (R26-GATE obs 2: no stated rule binds a budget figure to a check); it is not counted. A hand-edited stale budget (sB1h) is caught: r10_parts --check prints 'stale: parts_budget.json', rc 1.

D-R27-02 generator-revert seed (sB2b: the mcu_revision source line put back to '...byte-identical); Rev 11 and RM0433...', note regenerated with --binding-note): K-binding passes, as designed (saved note equals regeneration); the check.sh self-test test_r23_binding_note_rules_and_pin_table fails on the missing exception words. The gate as a whole catches it.

right_angle seed RA5 (SERVO2_MCU B.Cu chamfer at (30.55, 71.85) cut to 0.03 mm legs, a 0.042 mm 45-degree diagonal): route_check passes with one INFO non-critical micro_segment leftover. Both bends are 135 degrees, so the letter of the 45-degree rule holds, and AGENTS section 3 makes non-critical hygiene leftovers counted, not blocking. On a critical net the same seed would fail micro_segment.

right_angle seed RA6 (a 90-degree corner at SERVO2_MCU B.Cu (30.55, 71.85) with a zero-length segment added at the corner): route_check sees three track ends and reports only an INFO micro_segment, but DRC reports track_dangling at (30.55, 71.85), and check.sh's DRC step fails on it (same class as R25-GATE obs on a DRC-caught zero-length seed).

The D-R26-02 / -04 tests' copper_gap counts vias only where they are flashed, so the PYRO1_OUT via (11.63, 55.1) and PYRO1_GATE via (14.4, 53.3) inner barrels (no inner rings) are not in that measure. S-8 holds every such barrel at least 1.0 mm from any foreign In1 / In2 copper, 3V3 and 3V3A included, so no inner-layer spacing escapes the gate.

D-R26-02 / -04 spacing (PYRO1_OUT and the gate nets at least 1.0 mm from 3V3 / 3V3A) is held by RealBoardSeeds unit tests that check.sh runs on the checked board (R10_BOARD), not by a check_r10 rule; seeds P1 / P2 show they fail on a 0.1 mm via move, so the binding is effective.
